note: Missing subject — an invite always names the one subject whose factor it binds.
A claim code in the request — the relying party generates it; an inviter who chose it would know it before it was delivered.
A role in the request — an approver confers nothing, so an invite to bind one cannot carry a role.
ttl of zero — an invite must remain redeemable for at least a second.
Response without claimCode — the code is the second channel and is returned exactly once, here.
